user.title: Connect your PlayStation account
user.description:
1. Open a **private/incognito** browser window and sign in at playstation.com.
2. In the same window, open {npsso_url}
3. Copy **everything** shown there (a short JSON text containing "npsso" and "expires_in") and paste it below. The 64-character NPSSO value alone also works.
4. Close the window **without signing out**: signing out invalidates the NPSSO.

data_description.npsso: The JSON shown at the NPSSO page, or just the 64-character NPSSO value.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter a new NPSSO
reauth_confirm.description:
The NPSSO for {console} expired or was invalidated.

1. Open a **private/incognito** browser window and sign in at playstation.com with the same account.
2. In the same window, open {npsso_url}
3. Copy everything shown there and paste it below.
4. Close the window **without signing out**.

data_description.npsso: The JSON shown at the NPSSO page, or just the 64-character NPSSO value.

confirm.title: Enter a new NPSSO
confirm.description:
The NPSSO for {console} expires on {expires}. After that, the integration stops working until you enter a new one.

Submit to start re-authentication, then sign in at playstation.com in a private/incognito window, open {npsso_url}, copy everything shown and paste it. Close the window without signing out.

console_not_found.title: PS5 {console} not found
console_not_found.description: The console {console} is no longer on this PlayStation account, or it was renamed. Open the PS5 integration and use **Reconfigure** to select it again.

api_changed.title: PlayStation API changed ({operation})
api_changed.description: Sony no longer accepts the {operation} request (persisted query not found). Sony changed its website and the integration needs an update. The operation is disabled until Home Assistant restarts.
